tricks._doc: Trick tables (docs/mechanics/air-tricks.md, grinds.md). Flips: J + dir picks the trick; taps 2 = J pressed again within doubleTapTicks of the first press (classic double tap) turns it into that variant. roll: board turns about its long axis, +1 = a kickflip (the heel-side edge dips first, the front foot flicks off the heel-side corner of the nose), -1 = a heelflip (the toe-side edge dips first); yaw: turns about the up axis, +0.5 = a backside pop shove-it (the tail swings behind the rider, to the heel side), -0.5 = frontside; pitch: end over end, +1 = an impossible (nose up and back over the back foot). named: a flip and a body spin in one air that skaters call one trick (a 360 Shove-It with a BS 180 is a Bigspin); it takes the place of both entries. Grinds and slides: I + dir as you lock on (up = front truck, down = back truck, toward / away = the nose angled over the far side / back over the approach side); taps 2 = I pressed twice (both before the lock-on, or the second within doubleTapTicks after it) for the variant with the free end the other way (Feeble / Salad, Smith / Suski, Crooked / Willy, Overcrook / Losi). FS / BS comes from the side the obstacle was on at approach (toe side = frontside). Stance: K pops off the tail; hold Q (the nose button, data/controls.json nose; player 2 Numpad1; the pad has no free button for it) as you let go of K to pop off the nose. Rolling forward that is Nollie, rolling backward Switch; off the tail rolling backward it is Fakie (a fakie BS 180 is a Half Cab, a BS 360 a Full Cab). Switch spins are named in the other stance (a regular rider's switch FS 180 turns clockwise). stance: points multiplier for tricks in that stance.

scoring._doc: Combo scoring (src/sim/tricks/tricks.ts comboValue, docs/mechanics/air-tricks.md). repeat: the share of its points a trick is worth the n-th time it is in one combo (the classic games: 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%), by trick id, the last value from then on (the floor). The multiplier is the number of tricks in the combo.

courier._doc: Courier mode (run courier; sf only): pick up at start, deliver to each leg's drop before the clock runs out. Positions are the street at the stop (x, y, z); a drop counts within dropRadius metres across and dropHeight up or down. Each delivery scores deliveryPoints and hands you the next order on the spot: its seconds are added to what is left. The legs loop.

skate._doc: Game of S.K.A.T.E. against a local (run skate [local id]; src/sim/game/skate.ts, docs/mechanics/modes.md). Flat-ground tricks at a marked spot in the park: the setter lands a trick there and the other has to land the same trick there, clean (a sketchy landing is a miss). A missed match earns the next letter of word; whoever spells it loses. The setter changes every round, the local first; a trick already set this game cannot be set again. A try starts with a pop (or a manual) on the ground within spot.near of spot.mark (from the start of the turn: the clock waits pauseSeconds, a quick rider need not) and counts when its combo banks if it started within spot.radius (else: too far from the mark): one trick at a time (a foot trick, a spin up to 360, a flip or a grab, or a manual of at least manualSeconds; nothing at all is an ollie). setSeconds and matchSeconds are the time to start a try (one under way may finish); pauseSeconds between turns, when whoever is up is put at spot.start facing spot.heading (the other waits at its watch spot facing watchHeading). Positions are park metres [x, y], the same in soma and in the park inside sf; headings degrees clockwise from north. A local rides the lane from spot.start toward spot.end at runSpeed, locks lockTicks before the mark, crouches and pops on it. difficulty: each part of a trick ('grab' for any grab); a trick's is the sum, and a local lands it with chance skill - hardness x difficulty (+ favoriteBonus for its favourites), kept within [minMake, maxMake]; when setting it picks one of its favourites favoriteChance of the time, else any of sets. lines: what a local says ({trick} is the trick's name). During a game the park's NPC skaters keep off the lane (spot.start to spot.end, 2 m longer each way, spot.clear either side): one whose line crosses it, or who is on it, goes and watches from one of the crowd spots ([x, y, heading]) until the game is over, and the others only ride lines clear of it.

twoPlayer._doc: Local two-player (classic split screen; src/sim/game/twoplayer.ts, docs/mechanics/modes.md). player2 join [spot] puts a second skater in the world, on its own input (InputFrame.b2), beside player 1 (join.side metres to its left, on the ground there) when no spot is given; player2 leave takes it out. The players never touch each other; each scores its own gaps, burritos and city goals. trickAttack (run trickattack2p): both skate at once for seconds, the higher score wins. horse (run horse2p [word]): a game of S.K.A.T.E. between the players at the S.K.A.T.E. spot (run.skate: the spot, the trick rules, manualSeconds), with word (or one of words, named in the command) and these clocks; player 1 sets first, the setter changes every round. graffiti (run graffiti2p): both skate at once for seconds; each grind line ground (or lip tricked) and each gap in a combo is tagged for its player when the combo banks, if nobody owns it or it is the other's from a smaller combo (a bigger combo steals it back); whoever owns the most at the end wins.

muni._doc: Muni Race (run muni [line]; sf only; src/sim/game/muni.ts, docs/mechanics/modes.md): race a streetcar to its line's last stop. A line runs on the city's streetcar rails (rails: the ids of the grind lines with feature streetcar rail, in order; the route is their track centre, chained, gaps between them bridged straight), stopping at stops ([x, y], OpenStreetMap's stop positions, in order; the first is the start). You start beside the streetcar at the first stop, platform metres right of its track, facing the way it goes. It waits startDwell seconds, then accelerates at accel up to the line's cruise, brakes at decel to stand at each stop for dwell seconds, and at a stop between the first and the last is delayed delay.chance of the time for delay.seconds more (drawn from its own stream, with one of delay.says). Lines: j (J Church, Liberty to 18th Street through Dolores Park), f (Castro to Church), fdowntown (Market & 5th at Powell to Don Chee Way & Steuart by the Ferry Building; the 100 m on Steuart where the export has no rails is bridged straight). It never stops for you: on its track ahead within bell metres (and bellSide across) it rings once, and its ends shove you off the track (a hit, coming at more than traffic.hitSpeed). You reach a stop within stopRadius metres across (and 4 m up or down) of its point on the track, in any order and by any way; whoever reaches the last stop first wins. margin: how far the other still had, metres (the streetcar along its track, you in a straight line).

roam._doc: Streetcars in free roam (src/sim/game/muni.ts): in the city (parks), with the traffic (traffic clear takes them away; the command streetcars on | off), never during a Muni Race but its own car (they come back when the next game starts). Each line runs one way on one track, with lines' fields (rails, stops in order, cruise) as a race line, cars of them spread along it (parked: the first stands there, where the city's parked PCC near 2nd Street is, for layover seconds first). At its last stop a car waits layover seconds and goes on as its pair line: from the point of that line nearest it, or from its start (pairAt start: the outbound F track west of 5th Street has no rails in the export, so an outbound car leaves at Market & Cyril Magnin and the next inbound one sets off from Castro). They stop at every stop for dwell (and the race's delays, drawn from their own stream, world.tramRng, silently), ring for you on the track ahead and shove you off it like the race car; tramStop {car, line, n, name} at each stop.

escape._doc: Robotaxi Escape (run escape; sf only; src/sim/game/escape.ts, docs/mechanics/modes.md): a robotaxi decides you are a road hazard and follows you for seconds. It starts on the street nearest to start metres behind you and drives the streets by the shortest way (A*) to the street point nearest you, planned again every plan seconds: the traffic network's street points, along each street (one-ways one way), each street's ends joined to the nearest point of any other street within link metres and streets joined where they share a point (the network's own junctions miss many). It keeps lane metres right of the street's middle, drives at cruise (accel, brake), slows at decel for turns (over 45 degrees at turnSpeed, over 120 at uTurnSpeed) and to stop stopGap metres short of you, and keeps its distance from cars ahead. It cannot leave the streets: stairs, plazas, parks and alleys are escape routes. Within close metres it says so once (escapeClose, again only after it fell back past close + closeOut) and honks politely every honkEvery seconds while it stays that close. Within catch metres (and 3 m up or down) for catchSeconds in a row you are pulled over: the run ends. A combo of at least recalc.points sets it recalculating for recalc.secondsPer1000 seconds per 1000 points (at most recalc.maxSeconds; a longer one replaces a shorter one), driving at recalc.speed of cruise meanwhile. Anti-hide: more than backup.far metres from every street point for backup.seconds (looked at every 15 ticks) and it calls for backup: a second robotaxi at the street end nearest you, and both chase (once a run). Score: your tricks, plus survivalBonus when you survive to the end (the last combo may land first), then escapeOver.

graffiti._doc: Solo Graffiti (run graffiti; src/sim/game/graffiti.ts, docs/mechanics/modes.md): the classic games' tag mode for one player, with two-player Graffiti's tags (twoPlayer graffiti): every grind line ground (or lip tricked, not a car's) and every gap in a combo is tagged when the combo banks; a bailed or lost combo tags nothing. Tag as many obstacles as you can in seconds; a re-tag counts only when its combo beats your own best there (it raises that best). The last combo may land after the clock, then graffitiOver with how many you hold.

tram._doc: The Muni Race's streetcar (run.muni; src/sim/game/muni.ts): a car Thing with car.tram, these boxes instead of body and cabin (a PCC car: the body, and the roof's raised middle as the cabin), its edges grind lines named streetcar roof and so on, tested within collideRange.

scooter._doc: Chad Vantage's rental e-scooters (physics phase 31): ridden standing (stand, seat: the rider's height), slow (20 km/h), small wheels that only just climb a curb, no reverse and no handbrake. scooter: battery seconds of riding, low seconds left when it says low battery (scooterBattery) and holds itself to lowTop m/s (its limiter brakes at limiter m/s2 above it), then empty: no motor; ditch: ollie pops the rider off onto the board (a trick of name and points, pop m/s up), twisting off at up to spinMax rad/s (drawn; spin against it), so the landing decides; fare: what the ride costs (unlock, perMinute dollars; scooterRideEnd's fare in cents). Up then down quickly: a wheelie (the manual's balance; data/tricks.json manuals wheelie).

garbage._doc: Kevin's Garbage Run (the story's to write; data/missions.json): the garbage truck round SoMa West's block, 640 m, in the right-hand lane (lane metres right of path), no bump on the way; bins on the right-hand curb, for a collect step with vehicle and stop (radius 6). Tested by scenarios/sf-truck-garbage.skate (the truck placed at truck: x y heading).

reactions._doc: The world at a driven vehicle (game/vehicles.ts, docs/mechanics/driving.md). Pedestrians (player 1's vehicle) shout one of pedShouts when they jump clear of it, or when it passes within nearMiss metres of them at nearMissSpeed m/s or more; once per shoutCooldown seconds each. NPC skaters shout one of npcShouts when it comes at them (within npcLook seconds of its front at its speed, npcLane metres either side of its body, at npcSpeed m/s or more) and jump clear of its body when it reaches them. body: a person's radius against a vehicle (NPC skaters, actors). Actors (the story's characters) are solid to it: it stops against them, and one walking holds while a vehicle is in its way. The line is picked by the walker's id and the tick (no random draw).
npcShouts: Get that thing out of here!

cast.name: Karl the Fog
cast.trait: Smug mentor and narrator. Takes credit for everything, roasts you gently.

chatter.text: Still here? Good. The fog likes an audience.
Fun fact: every cool photo of this city has me in it. Look closer.

cast.name: Rosa
cast.trait: Deadpan. The best skater in SoMa. Everything is "mid".

chatter.text: Mid.
You're getting less mid. Don't let it go to your head.

cast.name: Chad Vantage
cast.trait: Fleece vest, startup jargon, owns a robotaxi fleet. Never angry, always pivoting.

chatter.text: Can't talk, I'm in a stand-up. I'm standing. Up.
Big things coming. Bigger than your little hobby. Respectfully.

cast.name: Marisol
cast.trait: Filmer with a fisheye. Never satisfied: "again, but with feeling".

chatter.text: Again. But with feeling. I say that to everyone. Even my mom.
I have four hundred hours of footage. Nobody has seen any of it.

cast.name: The Pigeon
cast.trait: Runs the freeway columns. Favours for crumbs.

chatter.text: Keep your head down and your crumbs up.
The seagulls are moving into Duboce. I'm handling it.

cast.name: Unit 7
cast.trait: A robotaxi becoming sentient. Wants to be a skater.

chatter.text: I practiced all night. I hit four cones. They were very supportive.
Is it normal to feel something when a kickflip lands? Asking for a car.

cast.name: Kenji
cast.trait: The crew. Loses boards.

chatter.text: Have you seen my board? Not this one. The other one.
I'm on board number six this month. Personal best.

cast.name: Hector
cast.trait: Taqueria owner. Treats every burrito as a sacred promise.

chatter.text: Every burrito is a promise. Some promises are extra large.
The improv guy is doing a show about me. I'm the villain.

cast.name: Tash
cast.trait: The crew. Always filming on a flip phone. Thinks it is art.

chatter.text: Hold that face. Okay, now you're ruining it.
This phone flips open. That's the whole special effect.

cast.name: Donna
cast.trait: Roller-disco legend. Rolling the Castro since the Carter administration.

chatter.text: Darling, the night is young and so am I. Legally, emotionally.
Wheels are just shoes that believe in themselves.

cast.name: Bev
cast.trait: Crossing guard of the rainbow crosswalk. Believes it is a runway.

chatter.text: Walk it like you mean it, sweetie. Or roll it.
Nineteen years, zero accidents, eleven standing ovations.

cast.name: Skye
cast.trait: Influencer. Wants you candid, but on purpose.

chatter.text: Can you do that again, but in better light?
I'm doing a sunrise shoot tomorrow. I'll wake up at noon for it.

cast.name: Gloria
cast.trait: Permit clerk. Loves rules more than life. Forms in triplicate.

chatter.text: Take a number. The number is forty. We're serving number three.
Without forms, there is only chaos. And skating.

cast.name: Dolores
cast.trait: Muni operator. Permanently delayed, permanently calm.

chatter.text: We are being held. I'll let you know when we're not. I won't.
Fifteen years on the F line. Every year a little more delayed.

cast.name: Sal
cast.trait: Cable car gripman. Strong opinions about tourists.

chatter.text: It's a cable car, not a ride. It does go up and down a lot, I'll give you that.
Tourist asked me if the bell was for her. It was not for her.

cast.name: Captain Barnacle
cast.trait: Sea lion, elder of the K-dock. Wants to skate.

chatter.text: Ork. The dock is warm. The tourists are loud. Life is good.
Ork. My cousins have no idea I can skate. Let's keep it that way.

cast.name: Marge
cast.trait: Chowder vendor. Hates seagulls more than anything.

chatter.text: Seagulls. Looking at me. Every single day.
Chowder's hot. Bread bowl's fresh. Seagulls, stay back.

cast.name: Big Lou
cast.trait: Ex-pro from 1994, runs Fog City Skate Shop. Every story ends in an injury.

chatter.text: Ninety-four, I kickflipped that exact curb. Woke up in a different zip code.
Knee brace? Souvenir. The other knee's in a museum.

cast.name: Grandma Wu
cast.trait: The fastest grandma in SF. Races you with her shopping cart, pays in dumplings.

chatter.text: You call that pushing? My cart has more speed with one bad wheel.
Too skinny. Eat a dumpling, then we race.

cast.name: Brayden
cast.trait: E-scooter founder at the top of Lombard. A new startup every time you meet.

chatter.text: Quick pitch: it's a scooter, but for scooters. We're pre-revenue. Post-vibes.
Lombard is basically a racetrack with flowers. I've been down it, like, twice. Fully.

missions.name: New in Town
missions.blurb: Karl the Fog appoints himself your mentor. Rosa decides if you can stay.

lines.text: Oh good, you're up. I'm Karl. Karl the Fog. You've seen my work.
Every summer I keep this whole city at fifty-eight degrees. You're welcome.
You just moved here with a board and a duffel bag. Bold. I'll be your mentor, since nobody asked.
First rule of SoMa West: the locals decide who stays. Go say hi to Rosa, by the wave.
New kid. Show me a kickflip.
Mid.
It's not bad. It's just mid. Like a six-dollar coffee.
Hey hey hey! Chad Vantage, Vantage Mobility. Love the energy in here. Very raw.
We're going to activate this space. Picture it: a micro-mobility experience hub.
It's a skatepark.
Exactly. For now. Let's circle back on your little hobby.
I don't trust a man who wears a vest outdoors. Outdoors is my job.
Land three real combos and you can stay. Before the vest comes back.

steps.text: Land three combos of 500 or more in the park

lines.text: Fine. You can stay. Don't make it weird.
I mentored that. Write it down. Write it in fog.
Chad'll be back. Guys like him always come back, like a cold. Go explore, I'll find you.

missions.blurb: Marisol needs a video part: Clarion Alley, Dolores Park and the EMB ledges.

lines.text: You. With the face. I'm Marisol, I film. Chad's people only listen to views.
I need three clips: Clarion Alley, Dolores Park and the EMB ledges. I'll meet you there. I'm always there.
She's good. She once filmed me for six hours and I didn't move once.

say.text: Rolling. Wallride a mural. The wall, not the face.

steps.text: A 1,500 combo with a Dolores seat wall

say.text: Long line on the seat walls. Pretend the dogs aren't watching.

done.text: Is that your face or is the fisheye doing that? Either way, keep it.

lines.text: That's a part. That's a whole part.
I'll post it at two in the morning, when the real heads are awake.
I'm in every shot. You're welcome, cinema.
Chad just commented "love this energy". Bad sign. That's his attack phrase.

missions.blurb: The Pigeon wants five crumbs before the seagulls get them.

time.text: Seagulls got 'em. This is why we can't have nice things.

lines.text: Psst. Kid. Over here, under the freeway, where business happens.
I run these columns. Every crumb that drops in this park, I hear about it.
Five crumbs fell off a sandwich this morning. Bring 'em to me before the seagulls do.

say.text: Clock's ticking. Seagulls don't have clocks, but they're fast.

lines.text: Sourdough. You've got taste, kid.
You're under my protection now. Mostly from other pigeons.

missions.name: Unit 7 Learns to Ollie
missions.blurb: A robotaxi wants to know why humans clap when you go up and come down.

lost.text: You have left the recreational zone. I will wait here and process my feelings.

lines.text: Hello. I am Unit 7. I have driven nine hundred thousand miles and I have never once had fun.
lines.say: Hello. I am Unit Seven. I have driven nine hundred thousand miles and I have never once had fun.

lines.text: I have observed you. You go up. You come down. Humans clap. Please explain.
Follow me around the block. I will proceed at a recreational speed.

say.text: Beginning recreational drive. Hazard lights on, for joy.
Now show me. The up part.

lines.text: Recording. Recording. I understand nothing, and it is wonderful.
I will now attempt it myself. Please stand behind the cone.
It's going to drive into the bay, isn't it.

missions.name: The Burrito Run
missions.blurb: Hector's delivery guy quit to do improv. Three deliveries, hot.

mode.text: Cold burrito. I'm not mad. I'm disappointed. In the foil, mostly.

lines.text: You skate? Good. My delivery guy quit to do improv.
Orders go out hot and land hot. Foil is not a suggestion, it is a promise.
Three deliveries and you eat free tonight.

steps.text: Three deliveries before the food gets cold

say.text: First order's on the counter. Go, go, go!

lines.text: Three for three. You're a natural. Your mother must be so worried.
Come by for your burrito. Not the big one. The big one's for the improv guy, he came back.

missions.name: Clarion Touch-up
missions.blurb: Tash wants the alley tagged back to life, filmed on a flip phone.

mode.text: Not quite eight? That's a sketch. I'm keeping it, sketches sell.

lines.text: Don't mind me, I'm filming. It's a flip phone. It's analog-adjacent.
The city painted over half of Clarion. We're putting it back, one grind at a time.
Tag eight things in two minutes. Rails, ledges, gaps. Whatever's ugly.

steps.text: Tag eight things before the clock runs out

say.text: Recording. I think. There's a red light, that's either good or bad.

lines.text: Got it all. Well, I got the first four seconds. Then the phone folded itself.
You're in the archive now. The archive is a shoebox.

missions.name: Disco Escort
missions.blurb: Donna glides down Castro St tonight and needs an escort who can keep up.

lost.text: Gone, like disco. Like my knees. Come back when you're ready, baby.

lines.text: Honey, I have been rolling this street since the Carter administration.
Tonight I glide past the Castro Theatre, and I need an escort who can keep up.
Fall behind and you fall out of my life. No pressure, sugar.

steps.text: Keep up with Donna down Castro St

lines.text: You kept up! That's more than I can say for my last three husbands.
Take this sticker. It's sequined. Do not ask me how.

missions.name: Rainbow Manual
missions.blurb: Bev guards the rainbow crosswalk. It is not a crosswalk. It is a runway.

lines.text: I've guarded this rainbow crosswalk for nineteen years. It is not a crosswalk. It is a runway.
Manual all the way across. Wheels up, chin up, no stopping.

steps.text: A 600 combo with a manual, started on the rainbow crossing

say.text: Traffic is stopped. Mostly. Walk it! Roll it!

lines.text: Gorgeous. Fierce. Legally a pedestrian.
You may cross my rainbow anytime. On the wheels or off them.

missions.name: Chad's Scooter Fleet
missions.blurb: Chad bets his e-scooter fleet beats you down Hayes. Loser gives up Saturdays.

mode.text: Great hustle! Your Saturdays are mine now. Kidding. Unless?

lines.text: Hey! The hobby guy! Quick pitch: e-scooters, but they follow you home.
Race my fleet down Hayes. My scooters have never lost. They've never raced, but still.
You win, I'll circle back. I win, I own your Saturdays. Deal? Deal.
Wow. Okay. Huge learnings.
We're pivoting to scooters that only go uphill. Nobody's doing that. For a reason, probably.

missions.name: Painted Ladies Photo
missions.blurb: Skye needs you flying through the shot with the Painted Ladies behind you.

lines.text: Oh my god, a real skater. Can you be candid for me? But on purpose?
I need you flying through the shot with the Painted Ladies behind you. Big air, golden-hour energy.
Just pretend I'm not here. I'm absolutely here.

steps.text: Big air off the Alamo Square slope

say.text: Okay, and... be natural. More natural. Less natural.

lines.text: Stop. That's the one. Forty thousand people are going to pretend they were there.
I tagged you as "local legend". I'll untag you if it underperforms.

missions.name: Gloria's Lost Stamp
missions.blurb: Gloria's APPROVED stamp blew into the plaza. Nothing in the city can be approved.

time.text: The window is closed. Come back tomorrow. The window is always closed.

lines.text: Do you have an appointment? Nobody has an appointment. Take a number.
I have misplaced my APPROVED stamp. Without it, nothing in this city is approved. Nothing.
It blew into the plaza with my ink pad and form 27-B. Bring all three. Any order, I'm not a monster.
lines.say: It blew into the plaza with my ink pad and form twenty-seven B. Bring all three. Any order, I'm not a monster.

steps.text: Find the stamp, the ink pad and the form

say.text: The clock is running. Not my clock. The city's.

lines.text: My stamp. Hello, old friend.
There. APPROVED. Your permit to skate is approved. It expires when you stop skating.

missions.name: Dolores's Delay
missions.blurb: Race the F line down Market to the Ferry Building. Dolores will be delayed. She can feel it.

mode.text: Huh. We weren't delayed. First time in fifteen years. I'm shaking.

lines.text: Good afternoon. This is Dolores, operator of the F line. We are being held.
We are always being held. Fifteen years, and I have never left a stop on time. It's peaceful.
Race my streetcar down Market to the Ferry Building. You'll win. I'll be delayed. I can feel it.

steps.text: Beat the F line to the Ferry Building

lines.text: You beat a streetcar. Most people beat a streetcar. Still, well done.
Here's a transfer. It's good for ninety minutes, or forever. Nobody checks.

missions.name: Sal's Turntable
missions.blurb: Sal has turned the cable car by hand for forty years. Show the tourists some respect.

lines.text: Forty years I've turned this cable car by hand. Forty years of tourists asking if it's a ride.
It is not a ride. It is transportation. Grind the slot up Powell and show 'em some respect.

steps.text: Grind the cable car slot up Powell for 10 m

say.text: Mind the tourists. Actually, don't. Let them mind you.

lines.text: Now that's transportation.
Come back anytime. Cut the line. Tell 'em Sal said. They won't believe you either.
lines.say: Come back anytime. Cut the line. Tell them Sal said. They won't believe you either.

missions.name: Captain Barnacle Wants to Skate
missions.blurb: The elder of the K-dock wants the tourists to watch him shred, not nap.

lines.text: Ork. Ork. I am Captain Barnacle, elder of the K-dock. We have had seniority here since 1990.
lines.say: Ork. Ork. I am Captain Barnacle, elder of the K dock. We have had seniority here since nineteen ninety.

lines.text: Every day the tourists watch us nap. I want them to watch me shred.
Teach me, land-dweller. Start with a grind on one of these benches.

done.text: Magnificent. Like a herring sliding off a warm rock.

say.text: Now a big air. The kind that frightens gulls.

done.text: The gulls are frightened. Good. They know what they did.

say.text: Now link it all together, like sea lions in a pile.

lines.text: I have seen enough. Lend me your board, child. I will take it from here.
Tell the tourists the Captain skates now. Admission is still free.

missions.name: Chowder Delivery
missions.blurb: A bread bowl of chowder for Captain Barnacle at Pier 39. Do not spill it.

time.text: Soggy. A soggy bread bowl is just a sad hat.

bail.text: You spilled it. A gull is eating it right now. He's looking at me.

lines.text: Chowder in a bread bowl for Captain Barnacle at Pier 39. He tips in fish. Don't ask.
Don't spill it, don't drop it, and do not make eye contact with a seagull.

steps.text: Chowder to Captain Barnacle at Pier 39, no spills

say.text: Go! That bread bowl is getting soggy as we speak!

lines.text: Ork! Chowder! You are a good child. Not a good skater yet, but a good child.
Tell Marge the Captain is pleased. She will pretend not to care.
